heading: top-left
name: 精選圖文並排＋三欄網格＋置中按鈕
desc: 四角圓角的滿寬區塊：靠左的標題組下方先放一個左圖右文的精選項目，接著是每列三個的無外框網格，最下方置中一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊左右貼齊畫面邊緣；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放副標，沒有時省略；區塊標題明顯大於各項目的標題。標題組下方是一個精選項目，左右兩欄各佔約一半：左側是一張橫式圖片，右側文字欄垂直置中，依序為標題（可多行）、說明文字，下方可放次要文字與小標籤，沒有時省略；精選項目的標題大於下方網格項目的標題。精選項目下方是多個項目排成的網格，每列三個、等寬，圖片同一比例；每個項目無外框：橫式圖片在上，下方是標題（可多行），可放次要文字與小標籤，沒有時省略。網格下方置中放一顆按鈕。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，網格每列數量可減為兩個。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，由上而下為標題組、精選項目、網格、按鈕。精選項目改為圖片在上、文字在下，圖片比文字更寬，左右只留很窄的邊，幾乎延伸到畫面邊緣。網格每列一個項目。按鈕改為靠左。區塊仍左右貼齊畫面邊緣，四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。

en.name: Featured side-by-side item + three-column grid + centered button
en.desc: A full-width section with all four corners rounded: below a left-aligned heading group sits a featured item with image left and text right, followed by a borderless grid of three per row, with a centered button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is flush with the left and right edges of the screen; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a subheading below; omit it when there is no content. The section title is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group is one featured item in two columns of about half each: on the left a single landscape image, on the right a text column, vertically centered, containing a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description, optionally followed by secondary text and a label; omit them when there is no content. The featured item's title is larger than the titles of the grid items below. Below the featured item, multiple items are arranged in a grid of three per row, equal in width, with images in the same proportion. Each item has no border: a landscape image on top, then a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with secondary text and a label; omit them when there is no content. Centered below the grid is a single button.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout; the grid may drop to two items per row.
en.mobile: Everything stacks vertically, from top to bottom: heading group, featured item, grid, button. The featured item becomes image on top and text below; the image is wider than the text, with only a very narrow margin on each side, extending almost to the screen edges. The grid shows one item per row. The button becomes aligned left. The section stays flush with the left and right edges of the screen, with all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) rounded.
